name: Non-parametric tests (Mann-Whitney, Wilcoxon, Kruskal-Wallis)
when_to_use: Same group comparisons as the t-test/ANOVA, when the dependent variable is not normally distributed or the sample is small; ordinal or non-normal metric data.
notes: The same group comparisons as the t-test/ANOVA, but without requiring the data to follow a normal distribution. Applications: data with outliers or small samples, common in internal surveys.

expected_input.question: Do the groups differ when normality cannot be assumed?

pdca_use: Check phase: same before/after or between-group comparison when the indicator is not normally distributed (common in small PDCA datasets) — still a deterministic calculation.

plain_explanation.purpose: Compare groups without assuming the data have a 'normal' shape.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the sample is small, has extreme values or is a ranking (score from 1 to 5).
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values or ranks and a group column.
plain_explanation.example: Compare satisfaction scores between two stores.
plain_explanation.diagram: values -> become ranks (1st, 2nd...) -> compare ranks between groups
